verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the Python SDK understands multiple MCP transports. That lets developers reuse existing MCP servers, or build their own, to expose filesystem, HTTP, or connector-backed tools to an agent. Hosted MCP is also offered as an OpenAI-managed tool. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of MCP use, and detail on which transports are supported and how they are configured.
